(1) Missing fund columns, 1,021,892: p5 Economic Development 380,227 (Community Development 201,597 + Principal payments 165,000 + Interest 13,330 + Bond issuance costs and fees 300), Debt Service 447,159 (General government 4,274 + Principal payments 410,000 + Interest 31,885 + Bond issuance costs and fees 1,000) and Street and Sidewalk Maintenance 194,506 (Public Works 66 + Principal payments 165,000 + Interest 29,440) have no schedule. (2) Different basis, 29,441: the p5 statement prints the General Fund's Bond issuance costs and fees 29,441 among expenditures (General total expenditures 9,410,913), while the p16 General Fund Schedule of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balance prints it under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) as 'Bond issuance costs (29,441)' (TOTAL EXPENDITURES 9,381,472 = 9,410,913 - 29,441); detail records it as printed (other financing, -29,441). Arithmetic: detail 9,708,269 (= 9,381,472 + nonmajor 326,797) + 1,021,892 = 10,730,161; statement 10,759,602 - 10,730,161 = 29,441 = the different-basis part. After the added lines the only remaining gap is that 29,441; the schedule line is kept as printed.
